code_summary: One independent masked bidirectional Transformer per category, with category routing and one selected checkpoint each. Defaults: length 64, hidden size 96, two blocks, two heads, dropout 0.2. Context and output item embeddings are separate; item bias is jointly trained. Training uses sampled softmax with 256 uniform negatives, final-position and interior masking, AdamW, seed 42, and validation checkpoint selection. The predictor writer loads the same architecture with strict checkpoint validation. No ensemble or checkpoint averaging.
